## Description

Verify the `preferredContentSize` and
`widthFollowsPreferredContentSizeWhenEdgeAttached` props of `FormSheet`. On
iPad, a custom size of `400 x 300` resizes the centered panel, also while it is
open. On iPhone in landscape, where the sheet stays attached to the bottom edge
(`prefersEdgeAttachedInCompactHeight` is on), the sheet takes the preferred
width only when "Width follows" is on.

## Note

- On iOS 26 and later, UIKit makes the iPad panel slightly taller than the
  preferred height (`320` for a preferred height of `300` on iOS 27.3).
- With "Width follows" on and "Custom size" off, UIKit uses its default form
  sheet width for the edge-attached sheet instead of the full width.

## Steps

### Baseline

1. Launch the app and navigate to the **Preferred Content Size (iOS)** screen.

   - [ ] The screen shows "Custom size: OFF", "Width follows: OFF", two
         switches (off) and "Open FormSheet".

## Steps - iPad

Run Baseline step 1 from `## Steps` first.

### Panel size

1. Tap "Open FormSheet".

   - [ ] A centered floating panel presents; "Sheet size" is not about
         `400 x 300`.

2. Tap "Dismiss", toggle the "Custom size" switch on, then tap "Open
   FormSheet".

   - [ ] A smaller centered floating panel presents.
   - [ ] "Sheet size" is `400` wide and about `300` tall.

3. Toggle the "Custom size" switch in the sheet off, then on again.

   - [ ] The open panel animates to its size from iPad, Panel size step 1,
         then back to `400` wide and about `300` tall; "Sheet size" follows
         each change.

## Steps - iPhone

Run Baseline step 1 from `## Steps` first.

### Landscape width

1. Toggle the "Custom size" switch on, rotate to landscape, then tap "Open
   FormSheet".

   - [ ] The sheet is attached to the bottom edge and spans the width of the
         screen between the notch areas.
   - [ ] The width in "Sheet size" is larger than `400`.

2. Tap "Dismiss", toggle the "Width follows" switch on, then tap "Open
   FormSheet".

   - [ ] The sheet is still attached to the bottom edge and is narrower than
         in iPhone, Landscape width step 1.
   - [ ] The width in "Sheet size" reads `400`.

3. Toggle the "Width follows" switch in the sheet off, then on again.

   - [ ] The open sheet widens to its width from iPhone, Landscape width
         step 1, then narrows back to about `400`; "Sheet size" follows each
         change.

4. With "Width follows" on, toggle the "Custom size" switch in the sheet off.

   - [ ] The open sheet widens to the system's default form sheet width:
         wider than `400`, but narrower than in iPhone, Landscape width
         step 1 (`540` on iPhone 17).
